decisions.topic: Producer identity, schema and source provenance
decisions.question: Which issuer-owned machine payload, state namespace, version and provenance become the governed Certifier-to-Registry producer contract?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Issuer-approved contract with version pin, scope, signed/attributed owner decision and representative source-authored samples

decisions.question: What receiving method and which Registry principal may consider a source-record registration request?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Registry governance-approved request contract, authority decision and refusal taxonomy; no inferred write permission

decisions.topic: Machine status, lifecycle and historical-version separation
decisions.question: Which machine statuses/versions and governed transitions control Registry records while keeping Certifier state independent?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Two owner-attributed approved vocabularies and transition/compatibility decisions with no historical record rewrite
decisions.note: OPEN_NARROWED: published is schema-allowed and used in historical SREG; machine lifecycle value-set/transition contract remains unresolved

decisions.question: Is a distinct Suite relationship needed alongside native registers, and what approved semantics and owners apply?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Registry/Suite jointly approved mapping table, distinct predicate vocabulary and authority-preserving serialization

decisions.topic: Authenticated receiver authority, replay, audit and readback
decisions.question: Who can authorize any receiving action and what verified audit/readback proof is required?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Approved owner policy plus independent enforcement/negative and durable-readback evidence; no write authorization created by this document

decisions.topic: Human/machine parity, source currentness and historical corrections
decisions.question: Which reproducible read-only evidence establishes historical/current source and Registry representation parity?
decisions.acceptance_proof: Executed owner-attributed read-only cross-format and historical version comparison, timestamped with explicit unknowns

evidence_checklist.required_evidence: Issuer-adopted serialization/profile and version identifier
Owner-specified canonical current-state and historical retrieval reference
Attributable origin, effective schema, source version and exact issuer status/outcome fields
Documented unavailable/unknown and bad-version behavior
Registry-approved intake operation/request format versus separate SREG output format
Receiving owner, delegated role, effective policy and negative response types
Independent registrability, validation, issuance and publication decision sequence
Explicit no-entry-created result until Registry-owned issuance
Separate issuer source version/status and Registry entry version/status/lifecycle namespaces
Registry-owned reconciliation of Base Schema values versus partial published controlled-values JSON
Governed machine lifecycle value-set/transition vocabulary and effective version
Explicit source state-at-use, separately checked current-state, unknown/stale outcomes
Registry-owned native registers direction SREG→source package
Separate optional Suite predicate semantics, direction, evidence strength and inverse policy
Unsupported mapping rejection; no silent references synonym substitution
Multi-relation and provenance semantics when individually supported
Named authenticated nonproduction caller and Registry receiving decision right
Rule-version and documented delegation/approval context
Replay-safe attempt identity, refusal and durable audit requirements
Independent actual Registry result readback/negative owner authorization evidence
Immutable historical source and SREG blob/version and capture context
At-use source state distinguished from current issuer observation
Registry human-readable representation compared to SREG record.json with field-level exceptions
Non-destructive correction/supersession event and provenance policy
